idea-plugin.name: Struct Layout
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the memory layout of a C++ class, struct or union - offsets, sizes, alignment, padding, vtable pointers and bitfields - computed by Rider's own C++ engine under the project's real compile configuration, so the numbers cannot drift from the actual build.

Right-click a type name and pick Show Struct Layout, or press Alt+L, or use Alt+Enter. All three open the same view.

action.description: Shows the memory layout of the type at the caret
